products.name: Mangalagiri Handloom Pure Cotton Silk (LT Pattu) Saree with Silver Jari Butta Border
products.description: Mangalagiri Handloom Pure Cotton LT Pattu saree featuring an elegant all-over small butta design with a rich silver 50 Jari border. The saree combines a sophisticated wine-magenta base with a contrasting emerald-green body, creating a traditional yet luxurious look. It comes with a running and contrast-colour blouse featuring matching borders. The running and contrast pallu is finished with delicate silver butta detailing, adding a refined traditional touch.
products.story: Woven in the traditional Mangalagiri handloom tradition, this saree brings together the beauty of handcrafted cotton weaving with timeless South Indian elegance. The rich wine-magenta and emerald-green combination, subtle butta motifs, and silver Jari border make it a graceful choice for weddings, festive occasions, and traditional celebrations.

products.name: Mangalagiri Handloom Pure Cotton Silk (LT Pattu) Saree with Silver Jari Butta Border
products.description: Mangalagiri handloom pure cotton silk saree with an allover small silver jari butta and 50 jari border. Comes with a running, contrast-colour blouse with matching borders and a contrast-colour pallu featuring silver butta detailing."
products.story: "Woven in Mangalagiri, known for its centuries-old handloom tradition, this saree blends the sheen of pattu with the comfort of pure cotton. Delicate silver jari work adorns the body and pallu, finished with a classic 50-jari border — a timeless pick for weddings and festive occasions."
